question: What practical advice does Albert Cheng offer product teams about using AI in Chess.com’s products?
expected_points: Keep customer value at the center when deciding where to use AI.
Choose the right technology for each feature rather than adopting AI just because it is popular.
evidence_quote: We're not just applying LLMs just because the new hot thing, you've got to apply the right technology for the right feature to provide value to the user.
